# Peza

> Peza is an online platform for Zambian university students. It brings student accommodation, campus services and a student marketplace into one place.

## What Peza offers
- Accommodation: find rooms and bed-spaces near campus and request bookings from landlords
- Services: book campus services such as barbers
- Marketplace: buy and sell items such as phones

## Coverage
- Serves students at universities across Zambia
